## Getting Started

New to ggsegverse?
Start with these resources:

::: {.quick-links}
- [**ggseg introduction**](https://ggsegverse.github.io/ggseg/articles/ggseg.html) - Learn the basics of 2D brain plotting
- [**ggseg3d introduction**](https://ggsegverse.github.io/ggseg3d/articles/ggseg3d.html) - Create interactive 3D visualizations
- [**Creating custom atlases**](https://ggsegverse.github.io/ggsegExtra/articles/customatlas.html) - Build your own brain atlas
:::
:::

## Cheatsheets

Three printable quick references, each a two-page PDF and an accessible web
page built from the same source. Every example is executed against the real
packages at render time.

::: {.cheatsheet-grid}
::: {.cheatsheet-card}

`geom_brain()`, view arrangement, palettes and themes.
